svg.aria-label: The citation-check mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Citation compliance agent, one pass: cross-check, format, DOI, retractions (agent); each issue (question); Corrected, logged (agent); Flagged for your review (agent); Revised wording suggested (agent); STOP: possible fabrication (stop); Removed, or kept with a note (agent); Citation audit report (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake agent: config.md, DOI checking strict or mark only [D24, O], the authors' earlier papers [AD8], the claims not to make [AI2]; a file given in words found by search [AQ] (stop); Script: cite-keys, check-urls [D15, D17] (script); Citation compliance agent: fetches each source and reads the passage each claim cites [D50, D22]; retraction notices from lookup.py [AD7]; clinical rows [AH]; versions of one work [AK]; claims list [AV7] (ruled); Passages that closely repeat an earlier paper: reuse of results is flagged, a plagiarism tool is suggested [AD8] (ruled); each issue (question); Corrected by a patch, logged (agent); Flagged for your review (agent); Revised wording suggested, no patch (agent); A claim the run cannot support (stop); Replaced by a candidate whose passage holds the claim, as a patch; flagged for you when none does [X] (ruled); A reference that cannot be confirmed (stop); The citation style to confirm: more than half the entries fail the same check [AV14] (stop); Script: cite-keys, check-urls, quote-check [D50, D22] (script); Citation compliance agent again, fresh, once [L] (ruled); Script: the three checks again, failures left named [L] (script); Citation report, checks.md (agent); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply, a script failed [C] (stop).

svg.text: academic-paper: one pass, no second run. The mode table lists no intake agent for it, while the intake page's mode list names it. paper: a retracted source follows academic-paper's retraction protocol (a ruling of plan 5); it differs only in that the replacement's passage is read in the run before it is used (D22, D50).
